strategy.extendedWindow: 30 days only with a live direct destination
strategy.coverageGoal: maximum practical coverage; never claim inaccessible or blocked listings were searched

nextRun.notes: Retry the 26 rate-limited LinkedIn Jobs query-location-page checkpoints after cooldown, then perform a new complete matrix. Continue authenticated Instahyre, deeper Cutshort and Wellfound pagination, fresh normal-post queries, blocked specialist details, broad portals, employer ATS pages, missing-listing trails, and the full active-link audit.

sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry the 26 HTTP 429 checkpoints from the 17-role-family by four-location matrix at starts 0, 25, and 50, then repeat the complete past-24-hour matrix and selected high-yield queries beyond start 50
sourceLanes.notes: The public LinkedIn Jobs endpoint recovered enough to attempt all 204 role-family, location, and page combinations: 178 succeeded and 26 returned HTTP 429. The sweep discovered 1,565 rows and 642 unique IDs before active and exclusion deduplication. Six direct listings passed freshness, eligibility, and live-route verification: RWS Associate Pricing Analyst, Target Analyst Promotions Insight, BlackRock Analyst Data Management, Talview Business Analytics Internship, Kroll Business Intelligence Analyst I, and Numerix Market Data Ops Analyst. Misleading same-day index refreshes were checked against the direct posting date; expired, over-30-day, canonical-closed, and duplicate candidates were excluded. The active audit closed ClanX and Data Eminence.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn employee, recruiter, founder, and company posts were searched independently across four query families. Search surfaced Nference, OneGuardian, Intervue, and an unidentified Bengaluru Data Analytics Intern post, but the posts were three weeks to several months old, deadline-expired, DM-gated, or had an unverifiable shortened route. No original post passed both the fresh-post and usable-destination gates.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then canonicalize the newly added startup and LinkedIn roles where an exact employer requisition appears
sourceLanes.notes: The ATS and missing-listing pass searched Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, and company-hosted pages. Exact employer pages replaced discovery links for Target, BlackRock, and Kroll; Paytm Deputy Manager Data Analyst (Finance) was added from its current Lever listing. Wells Fargo's internship deadline had passed, Circle K's canonical requisition returned 410 filled, Aspora had disappeared from its current Ashby board, and an older Paytm Business Analyst listing exceeded the 30-day window.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Authenticated Instahyre traversal, deeper Cutshort pagination, and current YC company boards, then recheck previously unavailable Wellfound IDs for state reversals
sourceLanes.notes: YC, Cutshort, Wellfound, and Instahyre were refreshed after the LinkedIn checkpoint recovery. YC surfaced only the three roles added in the morning plus a 3-year Explorex role. Cutshort results were senior or already represented. Wellfound search snippets claimed current FLIP, Snapmint, and KSKT roles, but every direct page returned HTTP 403 in this run and previously returned 410; they were not republished. Instahyre remained inaccessible without authentication.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: Internshala, Unstop, Hirist, AICTE, and specialist variants were searched independently. Internshala remained robots-blocked; LinkedIn exposed the fresh Talview internship and it was verified in the LinkedIn lane. Unstop and AICTE results had passed deadlines, while Hirist results were old or senior. No additional specialist-hosted destination passed the freshness and direct-page gates.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Indeed in an authenticated session or canonicalize employer destinations, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction
sourceLanes.notes: Foundit, Naukri, Indeed, Grapevine, and broad-portal variants were searched for fresh early-career analytics roles. Results were stale copies, generic or client-rendered pages, senior roles, or duplicates for which a better employer destination was found. Broad portals helped confirm BlackRock and Target trails but contributed no independent active destination.
